info.title: Cocktail Manager API (Preview)
info.description: Preview surface: the historic, unversioned (`/api`) REST API. Kept for backwards compatibility — new integrations should switch to the stable **v1** version. Authenticate with a workspace API key (Bearer JWT).

WorkspaceApiKeyAuth.description: Workspace API key (JWT), scoped to a single workspace. Create one under Workspace → Settings → API Keys and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each key carries a set of permissions; the required permission is documented per operation (see the `Permission` schema for the full list).

InstanceApiKeyAuth.description: Instance master API key — the `INSTANCE_MASTER_API_KEY` server env value, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is instance-wide (NOT scoped to a workspace) and bypasses the per-operation permission checks, so it authorizes every workspace operation. Intended for self-hosting / instance administration, not for third-party integrations. Call `GET /me` to introspect a token (its `isMaster` flag is true for this key).

SessionCookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
SessionCookieAuth.description: Logged-in user session (browser cookie). Used by the few workspace-member operations that act on the caller's own identity (e.g. leaving a workspace, creating/revoking API keys) and therefore do NOT accept API keys — neither a workspace key nor the instance master key.
